tools.name: decider_choose
tools.description: Pick ONE option from a set using the Strands Decider decision model (in-account SageMaker). Returns the chosen option, per-option probabilities and a calibrated confidence (>=0.9 is right ~95% of the time; below that, confirm or escalate).

state.description: The text the decision is about (may be empty when the question carries the whole task).

question.description: The decision to make, e.g. 'Which team should handle this?'.

options.description: Option labels to choose between (2 to 255).

tools.name: decider_yes_no
tools.description: Answer a yes/no question about a text using the Strands Decider decision model. Returns P(yes) in [0,1]; values near 0.5 are uncertain.

state.description: The text the question is about.

question.description: A yes/no question, e.g. 'Does this convey urgency?'.

tools.name: decider_score
tools.description: Rate a text on an ordered rubric using the Strands Decider decision model. Returns the expected level index, per-level probabilities and a calibrated confidence.

question.description: What to rate, e.g. 'How frustrated is the writer?'.

levels.description: Ordered rubric levels, lowest first (2 to 10), e.g. ['calm','frustrated','depressed'].
